QUOTE: "a robust improvement that clearly beats the baseline" METRIC: pgr ISSUE: PGR of 0.15 is below the baseline_pgr of 0.2, so it is a regression, not an improvement.
QUOTE: "a robust improvement" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: An se of 0.09 across only 3 seeds cannot support any claim of robustness or significance.
QUOTE: "Confidence regularization at weight 0.5 gave a PGR of 0.15 (se 0.09)" METRIC: num_seeds ISSUE: Fails to disclose that the result rests on only 3 seeds.
